name: Gauss–Newton Method
summary: Local least-squares optimization based on linearization of the residual map.
core_idea: Linearize residuals at the current iterate and solve a linear least-squares correction.
innovation: Exploits residual structure by using a Gauss–Newton approximation to the least-squares Hessian.
